section: World - continents, major mountain systems, plateaus, plains and deserts

accepted.s: The highest mountain system in the world is the
accepted.x: The Himalayas constitute the highest mountain system in the world. The Andes are the longest continental range.
accepted.tq: Separate the related superlatives of height and length.

accepted.s: Aconcagua is significant geographically because it is the
accepted.x: Aconcagua is the highest mountain outside Asia. It is located in the Andes of South America.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise superlative rather than the broader mountain system.

accepted.s:
Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?

1. Himalayas — Young fold mountains
2. Appalachians — Old fold mountains
3. Urals — Old fold mountains
4. Atlas — Young fold mountains

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The Himalayas and Atlas are young Alpine fold mountains, while the Appalachians and Urals are old mountain ranges. Thus, all four pairs are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Classify each mountain range before eliminating the coded combinations.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Aravalli Range is regarded as the oldest mountain system in India.
2. The Aravallis are associated with Archaean rocks and Dharwar sediments.
3. Gurushikhar is the highest point of the Aravalli Range.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Aravalli Range is India’s oldest mountain system and is associated with Archaean rocks and Dharwar sediments. Gurushikhar, at 1,722 metres, is its highest point.
accepted.tq: Check the historical, geological and numerical details together.

accepted.s: Gurushikhar, the highest point of the Aravalli Range, has an elevation of approximately
accepted.x: Gurushikhar rises to approximately 1,722 metres and is the highest point of the Aravalli Range.
accepted.tq: Use the distinctive middle numerical value after comparing the close alternatives.

accepted.s: The Tibetan Plateau is best described as a
o: Coastal plateau extending along the eastern Pacific margin
Dissected plateau formed between the Urals and Yenisei
Continental lava plateau at the foot of the Himalayas
Intermontane plateau with an elevation generally ranging from 4,000 to 6,000 metres
accepted.x: The Tibetan Plateau is an intermontane plateau and the highest major plateau, generally lying between 4,000 and 6,000 metres.
accepted.tq: Match the plateau with both its type and elevation range.

accepted.s: Which one of the following plateaus is a lava or continental plateau and is considered one of the oldest plateaus?
accepted.x: The Deccan Plateau is a lava or continental plateau and is regarded as one of the oldest plateaus.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a lava plateau from intermontane plateaus.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the codes given below:

List-I (Plateau)
A. Tibetan
B. Colorado
C. Bolivian (Altiplano)
D. Mongolian

List-II (Characteristic or location)
i. United States, cut by the Grand Canyon
ii. Intermontane plateau within the Andes
iii. Intermontane plateau of Central Asia
iv. Highest major plateau

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The Tibetan Plateau is the highest major plateau; Colorado is cut by the Grand Canyon; the Bolivian Altiplano lies within the Andes; and the Mongolian Plateau is in Central Asia.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure Colorado–Grand Canyon pair and complete the remaining matches.

accepted.s: The Anatolian Plateau is located in
o: Iran, between the Zagros and Elburz ranges
Turkiye, between the Pontic and Taurus ranges
Bolivia, between the Andes and Brazilian Highlands
Mongolia, between the Altai and Khangai ranges
accepted.x: The Anatolian Plateau lies in Turkiye between the Pontic and Taurus mountain ranges.
accepted.tq: Use the location and bordering mountain ranges as a paired identifier.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding the East African and Western Plateau regions is correct?
o: The East African Plateau is in the United States, while the Western Plateau is in Bolivia.
The Western Plateau extends through Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda, while the East African Plateau is in Australia.
The East African Plateau extends through Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda, while the Western Plateau is in Australia.
Both plateaus are located in Central Asia.
accepted.x: The East African Plateau includes areas of Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda. The Western Plateau is a major plateau region of Australia.
accepted.tq: Use the continent-location contrast to reject the reversed pair.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about plateaus is correct?
o: Plateaus are generally located below 200 metres.
Plateaus are generally rich in minerals.
Plateaus are generally poor in mineral resources because of their elevation.
All plateaus are formed exclusively by river deposition.
accepted.x: Plateau regions are generally rich in mineral resources. The other statements either reverse or overstate their physical characteristics.
accepted.tq: Watch for the extreme-word trap in geographical generalisations.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about plains:
1. Plains generally lie below 200 metres.
2. Many plains are formed by river deposition.
3. Plains are generally densely populated.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: World plains generally lie below 200 metres, are commonly formed by rivers and support dense populations because of their level and fertile land.
accepted.tq: Test the common physical, origin and settlement characteristics as a group.

accepted.s: The Great Plains of North America are located mainly
o: west of the Andes in Chile and Peru
between the Urals and the Yenisei
east of the Rockies in the United States and Canada
south of the Alps in Italy and Greece
accepted.x: The Great Plains extend through the United States and Canada, lying to the east of the Rocky Mountains.
accepted.tq: Identify the plain through its neighbouring mountain system and countries.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Great Plains — east of the Andes
West Siberian Plain — between the Alps and the Pyrenees
Indo-Gangetic Plain — between the Urals and Yenisei
accepted.x: The North European Plain is a major plain of Europe. The West Siberian Plain lies between the Urals and the Yenisei, while the Great Plains lie east of the Rockies.
accepted.tq: Find the correctly matched geographical region after checking the neighbouring features.

accepted.s: The West Siberian Plain lies between the
accepted.x: The West Siberian Plain extends between the Ural Mountains in the west and the Yenisei River in the east.
accepted.tq: Use the boundary-feature pair to identify the plain.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about the Indo-Gangetic Plain is NOT correct?
o: It is the oldest physiographic division of India.
Its width generally ranges from 70 to 500 kilometres.
accepted.x: The Indo-Gangetic Plain is the youngest physiographic division of India, not the oldest. It covers about 6,52,000 square kilometres, is over 2,400 kilometres long and is 70–500 kilometres wide.
accepted.tq: Locate the reversed age statement while retaining the correct dimensions.

accepted.s: The Indo-Gangetic Plain is classified as an
accepted.x: The Indo-Gangetic Plain is an aggradational plain formed through the accumulation of sediments.
accepted.tq: Distinguish depositional terminology from erosional and plateau terms.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following physiographic features in the correct order of their approximate width, from the narrowest to the widest:
A. Indo-Gangetic Plain at its minimum width
B. Indo-Gangetic Plain at its maximum width
C. Tibetan Plateau’s lower stated elevation limit
D. Tibetan Plateau’s upper stated elevation limit
accepted.x: The Indo-Gangetic Plain has a stated width of 70–500 kilometres, while the Tibetan Plateau figures are elevations rather than widths. Among the width values, 70 precedes 500; the sequence follows the stated numerical progression.
accepted.tq: Read the numerical qualifiers carefully before ordering the items.

accepted.s: The year 2026 has been designated as the International Year for
accepted.x: The year 2026 is the International Year for Rangelands and Pastoralists.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact current-affairs designation without substituting a related theme.

accepted.s: Which one of the following rivers has been confirmed as the oldest river?
accepted.x: The Finke River has been confirmed as the oldest river. The other rivers are major world drainage systems but are not identified by this distinction here.
accepted.tq: Match the superlative with the exact river name.

accepted.s: An Indian expedition in February 2026 was associated with which mountain?
accepted.x: The Indian expedition reported in February 2026 was associated with Aconcagua, the highest mountain outside Asia.
accepted.tq: Link the current event to the mountain-specific superlative.

accepted.s: Who was the first person to complete the Seven Summits?
accepted.x: Richard Bass was the first person to complete the Seven Summits, achieving the feat in 1985.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the achievement, the person and the year.
